title: Stability derivative at zero
statement: For any real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $\widehat f(S)$ denote its uniform Fourier coefficients and define $S_f(\rho)=\sum_{A\subseteq[n]}\rho^{|A|}\widehat f(A)^2$. Then $S_f'(0)=\sum_{i=1}^n\widehat f(\{i\})^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
